summary: A 400-seat research centre focused on applied machine learning opens in Gurugram, the company's third India facility.
The Noida edge computing laboratory doubles its floor area to support sensor network deployments across northern India.
A two-year fellowship programme for autonomous systems research begins at the company's Okhla campus.
The Santa Clara office will host chip design and verification teams working on photonics interconnects.
A joint research grant will fund climate modelling work on renewable grid integration.
A new team in SoMa will build compiler tooling for superconducting qubit hardware.
